name: PixiTween Director S02: repo skeleton, contracts, helpers, Meta clients, player
description: Builds the frame every other PRD plugs into: npm/TypeScript tooling with the three universal gates from story 1, the engine installed from ralph/ENGINE_SPEC, shared contracts (06 sections 3-5), file-backed stores, event bus and SSE, the four Meta clients with record/replay, the Spark LlmBackend, test doubles and media helpers, the Hono app with 501 stubs for later steps, the web shell with a Player stage built from the engine's public exports, and the `npm run live` dispatcher. Deliberately excludes any agent behaviour (S3b+) and the authoring core (S3a).

readFirst: docs/engine/README.md (engine behaviour: composition JSON, Player slot props, layer kinds, effects, validation; read before writing code that touches the engine)
docs/hackathon/06-contracts.md (all sections: this PRD implements sections 2-5 and 4b)
docs/hackathon/steps/step-02-director-app-skeleton/design.md (sections 3.1 engine cannot run on the server, 5 algorithms, 11 verified facts, 12 pinned versions)
ralph/ENGINE_SPEC (one line: how to install the engine)
manualGates: MG-1: owner confirms the engine is installed from npm (`reacthub-pixitweenjs@alpha`) or linked (`file:`), per docs/hackathon/05-repo-decision.md section 1, and that its dist/ was rebuilt after 22 May.
MG-2: owner runs `npm run live -- s02-smoke` (prints the estimate, about $0.03) and then `npm run live -- s02-smoke --yes`; paste the status/ms lines in the PR.

MG-3: after the P0 engine publish, re-run `npm test` and read server/engine/contract-issues note: record whether `import 'reacthub-pixitweenjs/schema'` resolves (the server then uses the engine validator).
extraGuardrails: The stubs story and the web shell story create files that LATER PRDs own (server/llm/glimmer-backend.ts, server/llm/router.ts, the five server/tools/*.ts files, server/authoring/api.ts, server/agent/*, server/listener.ts, server/art/*, server/review/*, server/clippy/mcp.ts, server/generate/*, the five server/http/handlers/{films,chat,review,generate,local}.ts, the web/src/panels stubs NewFilm, Storyboard, Review, Chat, GenerateApproval, Gallery, BackendBadge and ExportPanel, and web/src/capture|selection|export/index.ts). They are intentionally absent from `owns`: S2 only creates the typed stubs and never edits them again. routes.ts delegates to the handler modules, so later steps never edit routes.ts (contract D-1).
The Meta clients never write to the ledger; tools and agents record cost through ctx.ledger (contract D-4).
server/http/middleware.ts is later edited by S8b (appends rate limits) and server/boot.ts by S7b and S11 (append boot hooks): keep both as plain ordered arrays so those one-line edits are trivial.
